title: How did Microsoft screw this up? - Surface Pro X (SQ2) vs M1 Macbook Air
summary: Linus Tech Tips compares Microsoft's Surface Pro X (SQ2) with the Apple M1 MacBook Air, focusing on how Windows on Arm and x86 emulation perform against Apple's Arm hardware. The verdict is that the Surface falls well short.
why: Cited as evidence of how poorly Windows x86 emulation on Arm performed in 2021 compared with Apple's M1 and Rosetta.

quote.text: Windows runs at less than half the speed on Microsoft's own flagship ARM hardware.
